Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. Against the Eligibility Criteria , as per MSF Scope of Supply No-(1.4) Clause: Eligibility criteria- “ the bi dder or its OEM (themselves or through re-sellers) should have experience of manufacturing and supplying the same or similar item (i.e. Steel Bloom of size 300(+5/-0) mm RCS or above) by their own manufacturin g facilities or by their authorized dealer/agency to Indian Railways/ any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU/ Public Listed Company in last 3 years. In support of the same, bidder has to submit a copy of Perfor mance Certificate by their customer. The experience & past performance criteria of GeM GTC shall be sup erseded by this clause. 2. EMD shall be exempted for the MSE firms having UAM number or who are registered with the Central Purchase Organization or the concerned Ministry or Department (including OFs) or Startups as recognized by Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP), irrespective of the store for which they are registe red. The bidders have to submit documentary evidence (with validity) in support of their claim for EMD exemption. 3. As per MSE policy “if the bidder wants to avail the purchase preference, the bidder must be a manufac turer of the offered product for supply of goods”. In this regard bidder has to submit the declaration agains t manufacturer of the offered products/goods in firm’s letter head duly signed and stamped. 4. Bidder shall carefully read the clauses mentioned in ATC & shall attach the compliance of the same d uly signed and stamped. 5. Mandate Form to be submitted in prescribed format. 6. As per MII policy, if the bidder wants to avail the purchase preference, the bidder must upload a certi ficate from the OEM regarding the percentage of local content and the details of location at which the local value addition is being made. 7. MSE & Start-up firm’s should not be relaxed from experience criteria. Exemption will be applicable tur nover only. 8. Delivery terms: FOR,MSF 9. Performance Security Deposit @ 5 % of the Purchase Order value (including Taxes & Duties) is requi red to be submitted by the successful Bidder in the form of a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) or Fix ed Deposit Receipt from a Scheduled Commercial Bank notified by Reserve Bank of India, in the prescribe d format within thirty days from receipt date of S.O. in favour of METAL AND STEEL FACTORY ISHAPORE, A UNIT OF YANTRA INDIA LIMITED. PSD should remain valid for a period of sixty days beyond the date of c ompletion of contractual obligations, including warranty. In case the execution of the contract is delayed beyond the contracted period and the purchaser grants extension of delivery period, with or without LD, th e supplier must get the PSD revalidated, if not already valid. (Performance Security Deposit is, however, n ot necessary for contracts valuing up to Rs. 10 lakh. Above Rs. 10 lakh, PSD is mandatory). 10. OPTION CLAUSE: The Buyer reserves the right to place orders for additional quantity up to a maximu m of 25% of the originally contracted quantity at the same rate and terms of contract within the original D elivery Period (DP) as well as Refixed/ Extended DP. [Please note that if option clause is operated then Fir m have to submit PSD @ 5% of additional supply order value, if PSD is applicable]. 11. Payment Terms: 100% payment against Contractor’s bill only for accepted materials within 60 (Sixt y) days from the date of receipt of materials at MSF or submission of bills/documents & PSD (if applicable), whichever is later. 12. Please submit QAP as per MSF Scope of Supply. 13. Pre-integrity pact: Pre-Contract Integrity Pact will be applicable & to be signed and stamped in all p ages by the bidder.

14. Delivery Period/Schedule : 60 days 15. Only OEM or one of it’s authorised dealer/partner will be eligible to participate in this instant tender. I n case, an OEM and it’s authorised dealer(s) or more than one authorised dealers participates in this TE, th en the offer of such OEM and it’s authorised dealer(s) will not be evaluated. 16. Firm should read the ATC (additional Terms & Conditions) of this TE carefully and submit the desire documents along with Technical bid. 17. In case of EMD is exempted and/or PSD is waived, separate Bank Guarantee of PSD value is required to be submitted to act as financial guarantee for the Integrity Pact. 18. Arbitration Clause : As per Yantra India Ltd. Procuremnt Manual 2024. 19. Mediation clause : As per Yantra India Ltd. Procuremnt Manual 2024. 20. Against Bank Guarantee the firm must submit the same after verification of the BGs through SFMS se rvice of the issuing Bank. The Bank Guarantee will be considered as valid only after verification of SFMS se rvice otherwise same will treated as invalid. 21. T.C. & G.C. : Applicable as per Scope of Work 22. All other Terms & conditions will be strictly governed by as per MSF Scope of Supply & Specification in the MSF Item Nomenclature and YILSPM-2024. 23. As per MSF Scope of Supply, MSF may carry out capacity verification (if required) of the firm to asc ertain the supply capacity by the firm. Hence, the bidder has to be forwarded the supply capacity along wit h technical bid. 24.
